description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 4.9.0 of the OrangeHRM system, handling database schema updates, data insertion, and configuration related to themes and branding.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for updating themes, menu items, and related data in OrangeHRM version 4.9.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database schema updates and data insertions necessary for version 4.9.0, including creating tables, adding columns, and inserting themes and menu items.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, which is '4.9'.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a new menu item into the system, linking to a specific screen and defining hierarchy and order.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme into the database if it does not already exist, with specified variables.
